description: Exercise image generation prompts for workout-app. Use with batch image generator.
style_guide: All images should use a consistent style: clean white background, modern flat illustration, no text/labels. The person should be gender-neutral, athletic build, wearing simple gym attire (grey/black).

prompts.name: bench_press_demo
prompts.prompt: A clean, modern flat illustration of a person lying on a flat bench performing a barbell bench press. Show the person gripping the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, lowering the bar to mid-chest. Include a subtle downward arrow showing the bar path. Side view angle. Athletic person in grey gym attire. Clean white background. No text, no labels.

prompts.name: bench_press_anatomy
prompts.prompt: A clean anatomical muscle diagram showing muscles used in the barbell bench press. Front view of human body. Highlight pectoralis major in bright red as the primary muscle. Highlight anterior deltoids and triceps in light pink as secondary muscles. Medical illustration style but accessible. Clean white background. No text, no labels.
